Preferred ICT sessions

  • Daily / 4H macro context
  • NY AM data window

Session note: New York ET is the reference timezone. IST must be converted dynamically because the offset changes with US daylight saving time.

ICT models & market context

Models: Yield context, HTF levels, Rates reaction

Drivers: Fed policy, Treasury auctions, CPI / PCE, Growth and labour data

News catalysts: FOMC, CPI, PCE, NFP, Treasury auctions

Use ZN Daily/4H direction, Fed expectations and auction context as background. The playbook positions ZN as a bias tool rather than a default entry instrument.

Related markets: DX, NQ, ES, GC

Comparison discipline: ZN price down generally means yield up; correlation with equities/Gold is not a rule.
